name: safety-net
description: Blocks destructive tool calls before they run (force pushes, rm -rf outside the project, DROP TABLE, terraform destroy, writes to .env and keys, ...) and explains why.

extraProtected.title: Extra protected files
extraProtected.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for more files Claude may not edit, e.g. "config/prod.*, **/*.tfstate". A pattern without a slash matches the file name.

allowForceWithLease.title: Allow git push --force-with-lease
allowForceWithLease.description: Let the safer lease-checked force push through. Plain --force is always blocked.
